title: The epic-reconciler lease-lapse test fails under full-suite load
description:
FOUND 2026-09-23 running the full TypeScript suite: 'one Workflow per EpicRun, driven by the engine > completes a pass's writes under the re-acquired token after the lease lapses (tick e9n)' failed after 52s. The file passes alone, twice, and on main alone. It is load-dependent: a lease-timeout test racing wall time under parallel load.

Per the flaky-means-bug rule it is a defect, not noise. Note the scope: cloudflare/src/epic-reconciler.ts is slated for DELETION by mn7 (the TypeScript reconciler), so the fix may be to delete the test with the module rather than to repair it - decide that with mn7 rather than spending on a module on its way out.
acceptance_criteria: The test is either made deterministic (no dependence on wall time under load) or removed with the module by mn7, and the full TypeScript suite passes repeatedly
